subject: PO field gating and pricing packaging — evidence for preauth and net-term carveouts
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medtech.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com; procurements@medtech.co
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO metadata & discount prerequisites for DEV/PROD packaging

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow-up from procurement. We can move forward with the proposed annual commitment, but finance needs two things before issuing the blanket PO that triggers the 18% discount:

1) A copy of Redwood's PO template with required fields (billing entity, remit address, PO ID format).
2) Evidence of the proposed invoice cadence (weekly vs monthly) and an explicit statement on whether invoices will be consolidated per PO or per invoice line item.
3) Confirmation that the net-45 term is acceptable for the first two quarters, with net-30 reverting thereafter, or alternatively an early-pay credit schedule if we do net-30 throughout.

I attached our internal PO template for reference. Can you return Redwood's template and a short note confirming how you handle: PO field gating, split invoices, and preauthorized credits? If you require an advance/prepay, flag the amount and whether it can be held as a credit against future invoices.

Best,
Liam
Procurement Lead | MedTech Co
Attachments: medtech_po_template.pdf
From: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medtech.co>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata & discount prerequisites for DEV/PROD packaging

Hi Liam — thanks, this is clear and helpful. Short answers below; details and our PO template attached.

- PO template: attached (medtech_po_template_response.pdf) — required fields are: PO ID, billing entity name, remit address, budget code (optional), and a net-terms selector (Net30/Net45/Net60). We accept PO IDs in both numeric and uuid formats but prefer a stable PO ID per invoice.

- Invoice cadence & consolidation: We support both consolidated PO-level invoices (one invoice per billing period covering multiple line items) and line-item invoices (one per SKU or sub-entity). For annual commitments customers commonly choose: monthly consolidated invoices or weekly consolidated (if they prefer faster reconciliation). Consolidated per-PO is the default for enterprise commits.

- Net terms & early-pay credits: We can do Net45 for the first two quarters and then Net30 after that as you proposed, no problem. Alternatively, if MedTech requests Net30 throughout we can provide an early-pay credit schedule: 1.5% credit if paid within 10 days; 0.75% if paid within 20 days.

- Prepay/advance: We typically avoid large upfront holds for hosted customers. For Dedicated/reserved capacity we can do a partial prepay for capacity guarantees — usually handled as a refundable credit on the billing ledger. If you want an earmarked prepay, tell us the amount and ledger code and we’ll issue a credit memo.

Next steps:
1) I attached Redwood's PO template and a 1-page summary of our prepaid/credit policy (redwood_prepaid_terms_summary.pdf).
2) Vanessa (CC'd) will validate the billing entity text to match your remit.
3) If that looks good, we can generate a draft SOW amendment that captures the invoice cadence and discount trigger (18% on signed blanket PO + acceptance of the template).

Let us know which invoice cadence you prefer (monthly consolidated or weekly consolidated) and whether you want Net45->Net30 phased terms or Net30 plus early-pay credits.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: medtech_po_template_response.pdf; redwood_prepaid_terms_summary.pdf
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medtech.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: procurements@medtech.co
Date: 2026-08-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata & discount prerequisites for DEV/PROD packaging

Soojin — thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. A few clarifications from finance:

- They prefer monthly consolidated invoices per PO. Weekly creates too many reconciliation lines for our ERP.
- The Net45 for Q1/Q2 then Net30 thereafter is acceptable, but they want the early-pay credit schedule included in the SOW as an option (so our AP can choose per invoice).
- For the prepay: they asked if Redwood will accept a $150k advance credit for the Dedicated pool which would be applied against the first three monthly invoices if utilization is below the committed baseline. That advance must be refundable within 90 days of contract termination.

Also: we need one small sample invoice showing consolidated per-PO lines (redacted is fine) so treasury can validate the remittance and GL mapping. Can you produce a stub invoice?

If all that is possible we’ll push the blanket PO next week.

Cheers,
Liam
From: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medtech.co>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-08-18T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata & discount prerequisites for DEV/PROD packaging

Liam — all good, we can accommodate everything you listed. Summary of agreed points below (for your PO and finance):

- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated per PO (one invoice per month covering all billable line items under the signed blanket PO).
- Net terms: Net45 for Q1/Q2, automatic revert to Net30 starting Q3. Early-pay credit schedule will be included in the SOW as an optional toggle per invoice: 1.5% @10 days, 0.75% @20 days.
- Prepay: Redwood will accept a $150,000 advance credit for Dedicated pool utilization. It will be applied against monthly invoices if utilization is below committed baseline and is refundable within 90 days post-termination. We will record it as a refundable credit memo against the billing ledger and provide monthly credit balance statements.
- PO template fields: PO ID, billing entity (exact legal name), remit address, GL/budget code, contact email for AP. PO IDs may be numeric or uuid but must be unique per blanket PO.
- Sample invoice: attached (sample_consolidated_invoice_redacted.pdf). It shows consolidated per-PO lines and the remit/GL layout your ERP needs.

Next operational items:
- Vanessa will send the exact legal billing name to update the PO template (vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com).
- Karthik will prepare the SOW amendment that encodes the discount trigger and the early-pay credit toggle. Expect a draft by Friday.
- I'll prep the credit memo template and monthly credit statement format and send to your treasury team.

If you want, I can also include the refundability clause language for the prepay in the SOW; otherwise we’ll keep it as credit memo terms and include with the invoice appendix.

Thanks — looking forward to the PO next week.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_consolidated_invoice_redacted.pdf
